records.text: Erika Kirk’s account that pageants were not an early part of her life was untrue because she had been involved in pageants from the beginning
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Okay, so it wasn't about narcissism. She wasn't groomed. By the way, if you have to say that you weren't groomed for something, you probably were. ... Every single year from 2005 through 2012, Erika (Erika Kirk) was involved in beauty pageants.
Yeah, that's just, that's not right. That's not true. Erika (Erika Kirk) has been involved in pageants from the very beginning.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Public pageant records show Erika competed in Miss Colorado USA in both 2009 and 2010 before later Arizona competition, undermining a spontaneous first-entry impression; however, 'from the very beginning' is imprecise and the record does not prove every implied motive.
